starting_checkpoint.finding: V6 already persisted a sanitized FAILED closure after a post-V4 cognition exception and prohibited same-tick retry, but PersistentCognitiveSchedulerV2 allowed CognitiveCycleExecutionError to escape cycle_once/run_forever. One candidate-cognition failure could therefore terminate the persistent service even though the durable next-tick schedule had already been committed.

source_delta.change: Scheduler v2 now catches only CognitiveCycleExecutionError, re-reads the exact durable V6 FAILED closure from UnifiedDB, validates tick/schema/failure/no-retry invariants, returns HEARTBEAT_COGNITION_FAILED, and leaves the already-committed next_tick_not_before as the sole recovery cadence. Missing or malformed closure remains a hard integrity failure rather than being papered over.
source_delta.regression_added: A post-commit cognition failure must yield exactly one failed V6 receipt, must not replay the same tick identity, and a later scheduled tick can recover with a healthy inference function.
